description: Reference packet for the finite topological flux-sector calculation associated with issue #311. The objects are the six measured flux sectors of the certified icosahedral support: seam chains up to coboundary regauging, classified by puncture holonomy in the measured order-six class group. The hash-pinned carrier manifest supplies the oriented twelve-vertex, thirty-seam, twenty-face complex, and the hash-pinned measured global-form artifact supplies two-puncture witnesses for every class. The verifier derives exact twisted adjacency characteristic polynomials, local-coboundary invariance, Z6 fusion, finite composition of two selected seam-path-disjoint chains, and persistence of the charge-conjugacy partition through one edge-midpoint refinement check. It does not distinguish a quantum particle from a classical configuration carrying the same flux, construct asymptotic states, prove all-depth refinement stability, calibrate a mass, or identify a laboratory species.
